'''Catrona''' is a ''[[sul'dam]]'' from [[Seanchan]]. 

==Appearance==
She has very dark skin.

==Activities==
She is one of [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]]'s personal ''sul'dam'' who are part of the [[Corenne]]. She holds the leash of [[Mylen]], a former Aes Sedai. She smiles at her and claims she is now a "perfect ''damane''".
